name: D03_1_targeted_creature_cannot_be_blocked_other_attacker_can
notes: Printed: '{T}: Another target creature with power 2 or less can't be blocked this turn.' The Smuggler targets my 2/2 Bear A. Bear A and Bear B (not targeted) both attack. The opposing untapped 4/4 is offered a block of Bear B only (its ask lists Bear B and NONE, never Bear A) and blocks it: Bear A is unblocked and deals 2 (20 -> 18), Bear B is blocked and takes no life from the opponent. The Smuggler tapped for the cost.
